svg.title: What I'm learning
svg.desc: Self-assessed learning log. C / C++: 6/10, CS50 done, now writing my own drivers; Embedded systems: 5/10, Latency firmware, Making Embedded Systems; Bare-metal AVR: 3/10, registers, timers, interrupts; VHDL / FPGA: 2/10, still a beginner, but I love it; SPI · I²C · UART: 4/10, used in projects, not fully solid yet; PCB design: 5/10, Altium + KiCad, 3 boards so far; RF / radio: 2/10, dB, transmission lines, antennas, the LR1121; Electronics (CFC): 7/10, year 3; 3D printing & CAD: 8/10, pretty confident; FPV building: 9/10, been doing it for over a year now
